SIMPLE ENGLISH
Bisect uses a good and bad revision to narrow the range and find a commit that introduced a
reproducible regression.

commit එකකේ check කරන්න Jදනවා; test කර good/bad කියන්න.

Git මැද commit එකකේ check · කරන්න Jදනවා; test කර good/bad කියන්න.

git bisect start
git bisect bad HEAD
git bisect good <known-good-id>
# Test; repeat git bisect good or bad
git bisect reset

Expected: Git narrows the suspect range and eventually identifies a first bad commit, given reliable test
results.
What makes bisect effective? A reproducible pass/fail test and a useful good/bad range.
